summary: Cohere's trial keys are free evaluation keys limited to 1,000 API calls per month, with Chat models at 20 requests per minute. They unlock Command-family chat, Embed, Rerank, and more for prototypes without a payment method.
claim_steps: Create a Trial (evaluation) key - it is free by design.
Call api.cohere.com within the trial rate limits (1,000 calls/month).
